description: Not a lever of the fused stack: the device-side hand-off of the final step's GDN state (QWEN_FAST_PREFILL_HANDOFF, gate only, default off). The last step of every split prompt reads the B=1 GDN scratch to the host (240 blocking reads) and uploads it back before TPGatedDeltaNet.write_slot fills the decode slot; with the flag the graft's own write_slot is fed device-side clones of the scratch instead, so the read-back and the uploads are gone and the bytes written are the scratch's. Its three gate-only twins (-pf2-s4-ctl, -pf2-s4 and -pf2-s4-audit of the approved ship-4 profile) are generated by make_pf2_profiles.py and its window is references/fusion-jobs/PF2 (make_pf2_jobs.py). Unset (the default) nothing moves: the route does not even import the module.

smoke.what: PF2-H device-side GDN slot hand-off of the final step

image_files.reason: levern_route imports it at the attach once QWEN_FAST_PREFILL_HANDOFF or its audit flag is set (the device-side slot hand-off of the final step); an image without it refuses that boot

notes: Shared files this package edits: levern_route.py (the final step's hand-off in route and the merged route, and the warm; every change is off unless the flag is set), the fake ttnn of qwen_prefix_model_fixture.py (clone, and a toy write_slot that consumes its sources and fills the batched buffers like the graft's), profile_twins.py and the census tests that exempt generated twins.
